briefing.text: On News, Information Technology stays first (buzz 86.0, up 3.6; mentions up 305%; sentiment -0.10; NVDA, MSFT, AMD, INTC, AVGO), while Financials jumped from 11th to 2nd (buzz 85.1, up 20.2 on the day and 9.4 on the week; mentions up 126%; sentiment 0.01; BAC, UBS, MS, JPM, C). Real Estate (buzz 79.9, up 7.8, mentions up 239%) and Materials (buzz 80.2, up 6.2, mentions up 337%) also rose. On X, Information Technology leads at buzz 93.3 (up 0.3, sentiment 0.09; NVDA, MU, AMD) and Financials is 2nd at 91.1 (up from 4th; HOOD, SOFI, JPM, BAC), but Financials mentions fell 29% and Utilities mentions fell 80%. On Reddit, Information Technology leads at 94.1 (NVDA, INTC, AAPL, MSFT), with Financial Services up 13.2 (mentions up 145%, index-fund tickers) and Utilities up 11.8 (mentions up 123%, sentiment 0.08).

TTWO #1: Barron's lists it among stocks explaining today's market and a Yahoo piece says analysts expect about 7% more than Take-Two does; it fits the high attention and a 2.1-sigma, 6.3% drop.
NVDA #2: earnings are due today; headlines are about partners (Rockwell edge AI) and BlackRock's largest position, with 305 negative vs 144 positive articles, so the earnings date explains the rank.
KLAR #3: retail is bullish ahead of Q3 earnings today (positive 2, negative 0); the catalyst explains the rank.
HD #4: earnings today; headlines say the stock dips on CEO transition and fewer but bigger shopper trips, so the news explains the rank.
TGT #6: only Black Friday deal announcements; earnings on 11-18 are the likelier driver than the news.
GPUCOMPUTE #8: headlines are about AI chip stocks (Lumentum, SharonAI); it shares Nvidia's attention numbers rather than its own news.
DIS #10: earnings beat and a 33% dividend raise to $1.00 (14 positive, 0 negative articles); the news explains the rank.
KO #11 and WMT #12: no company-specific news; KO items are fund-holding pieces, and Walmart's earnings come 11-19.

TTWO ranks first mainly on attention (1.12 vs normal, 98th percentile), attention on X (1.16, 99th) and a 2.1-sigma price move; volume is below normal (0.72) and it has no catalyst date. NVDA is second on high attention and X attention (0.66 and 0.71) plus earnings today, though its volume reading is only 0.48. KLAR is third on volume (0.99, top percentile) and X attention (0.98), with earnings today and almost no price move (0.4 sigma).

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
